items.exampleEn: Scientists are studying the link between sleep and inflammation.
items.exampleZh: 科學家正在研究睡眠與發炎之間的關聯。

items.exampleEn: Germs can spread quickly in crowded classrooms.
items.exampleZh: 病菌在擁擠的教室裡傳播得很快。

items.exampleEn: High fuel prices crippled many small fishing businesses last year.

items.exampleEn: The movie had great actors, but the ending was really lame.

items.exampleEn: Sleep paralysis is a strange feeling that some people have when waking up.

items.exampleEn: A single teaspoon of soil can contain billions of microbes.
items.exampleZh: 一匙土壤裡可能含有數十億個微生物。

items.exampleEn: Sanitation workers collect the city's trash every night.
items.exampleZh: 清潔隊員每天晚上收集城市的垃圾。

items.exampleEn: The word diarrhea comes from a Greek word meaning 'to flow through'.
items.exampleZh: diarrhea 這個字源自意思是「流過」的希臘字。

items.sentenceEn: Washing your hands with soap removes most germs.
items.sentenceZh: 用肥皂洗手可以去除大部分的細菌。

items.audioEn: Sorry I'm late. My excuse is lame, I know, but I really did miss the bus.
items.audioZh: 抱歉我遲到了。我知道這藉口很遜，但我真的錯過了公車。

items.sentenceEn: The heavy snow crippled the city's roads and trains for three days.
items.sentenceZh: 大雪讓這座城市的道路和火車癱瘓了三天。

items.sentenceEn: Some microbes inside our bodies actually help us break down food.
items.sentenceZh: 我們體內的有些微生物其實會幫助分解食物。

items.stemEn: Better ____, such as clean toilets and safe water, has improved life in many villages.
items.stemZh: 更好的衛生設施，例如乾淨的廁所和安全的水，改善了許多村莊的生活。

items.stemEn: When the manager couldn't decide, the whole project fell into a state of ____.
items.stemZh: 經理一直無法做決定，整個專案陷入停擺狀態。

items.passageEn: In our science class, we learned about the tiny world of microbes. Most of them are harmless, and some are even helpful. However, a few germs can cause illnesses such as diarrhea, especially where sanitation is poor. Our teacher explained that the body fights harmful germs through inflammation, which is why a cut can turn red and warm. Scientists are also studying rare cases of paralysis caused by infections. One student offered a lame excuse for not finishing the homework: he said hungry microbes had found it yummy and eaten it! The class laughed, and the teacher said the joke was better than the excuse.
items.passageZh: 在自然課上，我們認識了微生物的微小世界。大部分微生物都無害，有些甚至有益。不過，少數病菌會引起腹瀉等疾病，尤其是在衛生條件差的地方。老師說明，身體會透過發炎來對抗有害的病菌，所以傷口才會變紅變熱。科學家也在研究由感染引起的罕見癱瘓病例。有個同學為沒寫完作業找了個很遜的藉口：他說飢餓的微生物覺得作業很好吃，就把它吃掉了！全班都笑了，老師說這個笑話比藉口還好。

options: 因為那天的天氣實在太熱
因為傷口不小心碰到熱水

referenceEn: The strike crippled the country's mail system.
The strike crippled the postal system across the country.
rubricZh: cripple 當動詞是「使癱瘓、使嚴重受損」（例如 crippled the system 等）
